notes.title: Summer Rivals 2025: The rivalry of this summer is coming!
notes.notes: [h2]☀️ Holidays? Beach? A sunshade? [b]Not this time…[/b][/h2][p]This season, [b]real tough ones[/b] are sitting in front of their screens, sweating over sudoku, because it’s time for [b]SUMMER RIVALS 2025[/b] – our [b]first official ranking event[/b]. And yes, there will be [b]XP[/b]. A [b]lot[/b] of XP. But [b]not for slackers[/b]… So [b]get to work![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🎯 What’s this all about?[/h2][p]From [b]July 1 to August 31[/b], in [b]every game mode[/b], we’re activating the [b]XP bonus system[/b] that will define your [b]position in the leaderboard[/b]. [b]The more difficult the level[/b] and the [b]earlier the day[/b] – the [b]bigger the XP gain[/b]. Doesn’t matter if you play [b]solo[/b] or in [b]co-op[/b]. In short: [b]I play[/b] = I get [b]more XP[/b] than usual. [b]I play harder[/b] = I get [b]even more XP[/b]. [b]I play earlier[/b] = I get [b]more XP than my buddy[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2]🔥 How does the XP Boost work?[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🎚️ Fixed bonus based on difficulty level[/b][/h3][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][b]Level[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Bonus[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Tutorial[/p][/td][td][p][b]+1% XP[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Very Easy[/p][/td][td][p][b]+2% XP[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Easy[/p][/td][td][p][b]+4% XP[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Medium[/p][/td][td][p][b]+8% XP[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Hard[/p][/td][td][p][b]+16% XP[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Very Hard[/p][/td][td][p][b]+32% XP[/b][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]⏳ Daily multiplier – XP melts every day[/b][/h3][p]The bonuses above are multiplied by a [b]special daily multiplier[/b], which [b]decreases by 1% each day[/b]:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][b]Date[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]Multiplier[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]July 1[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]+62%[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]July 2[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]+61%[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]…[/p][/td][td][p]…[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]August 29[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]+3%[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]August 30[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]+2%[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]August 31[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]+1%[/b][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]📌 [b]The earlier you play – the bigger the boost.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]📈 Examples[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Play [b]Very Hard[/b] on [b]Day 1[/b] → [b]+32% × +62% = +51.84% XP[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Play [b]Medium[/b] on [b]Day 62[/b] → [b]+8% × +1.01 = +8.08% XP[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🧠 Remember![/b][/h3][p]🏆 [b]Leaderboard is based on XP[/b] – those who [b]play smart and early[/b] will rise![/p][p]💪 [b]The boost fades daily[/b] – [b]you lose 1% every day![/b][/p][p]🧩 [b]Harder levels pay more[/b] – this event [b]isn’t for slackers[/b], it’s for [b]thinkers[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]😵‍💫 It’s almost time![/h2][p][b]The holidays will end. The boost will end. But the leaderboard will remain. [/b]And only one question will matter: [b]Will you be on it? [/b]We’ll find out. [b]SudokuNexus Summer Rivals 2025[/b] runs from [b]July 1 to August 31, 2025[/b] – [b]starts at midnight, ends at midnight.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Got a head for numbers? Try the SudokuNexus demo!
notes.notes:
🔥 On May 30th at 6:00 PM CET, something’s dropping that will set your brain on fire – the SudokuNexus demo! 🚀🧩 This ain’t your grandma’s sudoku next to the horoscopes. This is a digital arena of logical warfare, where style, speed, and challenge reign supreme! 💼🧠💡

notes.title: We are back after a long-term break!
notes.notes:
🎉 We’re back with fresh updates!
After a longer break, we’re excited to bring you another batch of improvements and features that take SudokuNexus to the next level. Check out what we’ve prepared in the latest update – from technical enhancements to brand-new additions that will make your gameplay even more enjoyable!

[h1]🌍 English Language Version[/h1]

With players from around the world in mind, we’re preparing a full English language version of SudokuNexus. The translation of the interface and in-game messages is in its final stages and will be released in one of the upcoming updates. This will make the game more accessible and open to a new global community.

[h1]🖥️ Fullscreen Mode[/h1]

We’re introducing fullscreen mode to significantly improve the gameplay experience – especially for players who enjoy fully immersing themselves in the world of Sudoku. You’ll be able to enable it from the settings menu. We’re also working to ensure it runs smoothly across all devices, and it might become the default mode in the future.

[b]NOTE: This mode currently only works with a resolution of 1960 x 1080![/b]

[h1]⚙️ Extended Game Settings[/h1]

Time for more personalization! The current settings are quite basic, so we’re planning to expand them step by step. In future versions, you’ll find new options that let you customize the look, pace, and style of the game to better suit your preferences. We want every player to enjoy Sudoku their own way.

notes.title: SudokuNexus Developer Notes #1: What’s new?
notes.notes:
Recently, things have been a bit quiet on our end, but it’s just an illusion – we’ve been working hard behind the scenes on the development of SudokuNexus! Very soon, we’ll begin rolling out a series of updates that will significantly change your gameplay experience. Each update will focus on specific aspects of the game and will introduce long-awaited improvements and new features.

Below, we present what we’re currently working on – some of these features will be added to the game very soon, while others will appear in upcoming updates.

[h1]🌍 English Language Version[/h1]

With players from all over the world in mind, we’re preparing a full English language version of SudokuNexus. The translation of the interface and messages is in its final stages and will be available in one of the upcoming updates. This will make the game more accessible and open to a new community.

[h1]🖥️ Fullscreen Mode[/h1]

We’re introducing fullscreen mode, which will significantly enhance the gameplay experience – especially for players who like to fully immerse themselves in the world of Sudoku. It will be available in the settings menu. We’re also working to ensure it functions smoothly on all devices, and it may become the default mode in the future.

[h1]⚙️ Expanded Game Settings[/h1]

Time for more personalization! The current settings are quite basic, so we plan to gradually expand them. Future versions will include new options that allow players to customize the look, pace, and style of the game to their liking. We want everyone to play the way they enjoy the most.

[h1]🤝 Multiplayer Reworked[/h1]

We’ll be temporarily disabling the current standard multiplayer mode – it still contains too many bugs affecting the smoothness and correctness of gameplay. But don’t worry! We’ll rebuild the multiplayer system from scratch, fixing all the issues and expanding its capabilities. When it returns, it will be available in a fully improved version – also within the new game modes.

[h1]🧪 New Game Modes[/h1]

We’re preparing two brand-new game modes that will bring a fresh twist and more variety to the gameplay. Their release is planned in the coming weeks, after the major updates are rolled out. We’ll reveal more details soon, but we can say this – it’s going to be exciting!

Thank you for being with us! Your suggestions, feedback, and engagement mean the world to us. It’s thanks to you that SudokuNexus continues to grow and evolve. An exciting time lies ahead, and we can’t wait for you to try out all the new features!

notes.title: 🚨 BREAKING NEWS: Classic Sudoku Co-op Mode is Here! 🚨
notes.notes:
Tired of solving Sudoku alone, staring at that one cursed number, wondering if it’s really a “9” or just a full-blown panic attack? Now you can drag a friend into the Sudoku struggle! 🎉

[b]👥 CO-OP MODE in Standard Sudoku![/b]
Solve ONE Sudoku together – what could possibly go wrong, right? RIGHT?! 😈

[b]🆕 What’s in store for the brave souls?[/b]
✅ Random partner or a friend – because no one should suffer alone.
✅ One board, two brains – but does that really double your chances of success? Hehehe… well…
✅ No timer, no pressure – just you, the numbers, and the silent terror when your teammate puts a “5” where there was OBVIOUSLY a “6” from the very beginning!

[b]⚠️ WARNING![/b]
👀 Beware of Sudoku maniacs – they might scream “WHAT ARE YOU DOING?!” more often than they actually play.
💀 Prepare for confrontations – because there’s always that one “Sudoku expert” who “sees everything instantly.”
🧠 Friendship test guaranteed – if you still like each other after this, nothing can break you apart.

[b]💡 PROTIP: [/b]When you run out of ideas, stare at the ceiling and say, “hmm, interesting…” – it makes you look like a pro.

🔄 The update has landed – team up and see if you can survive without arguing!

And if you think Standard Sudoku is the only one getting a co-op mode… well, let’s just say other modes might be plotting something similar very soon. 😏

notes.title: 🧠🔥 SudokuNexus NEWS: YOU’RE A LEGEND… OR YOU HAVE A PROBLEM! 🎉
notes.notes:
Is it talent, determination, or just an addiction to numbers? It doesn’t matter! If you’ve spent more time in SudokuNexus than you probably should, we have exclusive achievements for the real veterans!

🔔 Check which ones you’ve already unlocked! 👇

[h3]🏆 No Life?[/h3]

💬 Played 1000 games. Maybe take a break… or just one more round?

[b]✨ If you’re still unsure how to get this:[/b]
✅ Start playing Sudoku.
✅ Stop keeping track of time spent in SudokuNexus.
✅ Open your eyes – you’ve played 1000 games.

[b]📢 We’re not saying anything, but…[/b]
If your answer to “What have you been up to lately?” is “Playing Sudoku”, then the title of this achievement probably makes sense.

[h3]🏆 Come on, Give It a Rest![/h3]

💬 Beat Sudoku 1000 times, and you’ll officially become a SudokuNexus genius.

[b]✨ In short:[/b]
✅ Think fast.
✅ Fill in the numbers without hesitation.
✅ Do it 1000 times, because who needs a break?

[b]📜 Just a small digression…[/b]
Einstein once said that genius is 1% talent and 99% hard work. We’d add a few percent of obsession to that.

[h3]🏆 The Millennium Meltdown[/h3]

💬 If Sudoku has crushed your dignity 1000 times, we’ll reward you with this unique title. We hope you’ll still come back for more defeats.

[b]✨ Quick guide for those interested:[/b]
✅ Make mistakes.
✅ Click “New Game” with full confidence.
✅ Repeat 1000 times.

[b]📜 We’re not saying anything, but…[/b]
If you’ve lost this many times and still haven’t quit, you’re either a legend of persistence or just enjoy suffering.

[h3]🏆 Minister of Digital Affairs[/h3]

💬 Got this achievement? Congratulations! You’ve officially made more mistakes than the average politician.

[b]✨ Want this title? Here’s the recipe:[/b]
✅ Place numbers at random.
✅ Don’t check if they fit.
✅ Reach 1000 mistakes and smile like you’re on camera during an interview.

[b]📜 Fun fact on the side…[/b]
Some mistakes go down in history. Yours, unfortunately, only show up in the SudokuNexus stats.


[b]🎉 Which of these have you already unlocked? Or maybe you’re just a few games away from the elite club?

💬 Brag about your Sudoku Legend status!

🔥 SudokuNexus – for those who count faster than others think! 😆[/b]

notes.title: 🧩 Alert! Multiplayer is coming – because Sudoku tastes better in a duo… 🤯
notes.notes:
💡 Think Sudoku is a peaceful logic game? HA! Throw your friends into the mix and brace yourself for pure mathematical mayhem! 😆

[b]🔥 Three modes, one goal – survive together![/b]
🔹 [b]Standard[/b] – Classic Sudoku… but now you have a witness to your mistakes!
⏳ [b]Time Attack[/b] – Sudoku against the clock? In panic mode? With someone insisting, “That three definitely fits here”? Good luck.
⚡ [b]Brainstorm[/b] – Two brains, one big disaster.

⏳ Coming soon! Gather your crew, sharpen your mind, and get ready for Sudoku like never before! 🚀

notes.title: 🚀 SudokuNexus – Sezon Testowy Startuje! 🏆🔢
notes.notes:
🚀 SudokuNexus – Sezon Testowy Startuje! 🏆🔢

🔔 Dźwięk werbli… Nadszedł ten moment! Rankingi zostały włączone! Teraz możesz oficjalnie udowodnić, że jesteś sudoku-ninją, sudoku-mistrzem, a może nawet sudoku-bogiem (albo przynajmniej nie wypełniasz pól losowo).

🔥 Rywalizuj, ścigaj się, wspinaj na szczyt!
💀 Uważaj na tilt – sudoku może być zdradliwe.
🎯 Cel: numer 1 na liście rankingowej (albo chociaż wyżej niż znajomy).

Nie ma wymówek. Czas na sudoku-honor! 😎

notes.title: Statystyki i ranking już (prawie) są!
notes.notes:
Zgodnie z obietnicą stało się! W dniu dzisiejszym opublikowana została aktualizacja do wersji 0.27 gry SudokuNexus w ramach której udostępniamy dla Was rankingi oraz statystyki. Oprócz tego wprowadziliśmy kilka istotnych zmian i poprawek o których opowiemy poniżej.

[h1]Statystyki i ranking[/h1]

W ramach aktualizacji 0.27 pojawi się do Waszej dyspozycji zakładka Ranking w której sprawdzicie swoje pozycje w rankingach oraz dotychczasowe statystyki. Przeglądając tą zakładkę zauważycie, że wprowadziliśmy podział na tryby oraz na wyniki ogólne. Wiemy, że obecnie dostępne statystyki są dość proste i mało szczegółowe, ale z biegiem czasu na pewno będziemy je dalej rozwijać. 

Jeśli chodzi o system rankingów warto wspomnieć o zasadzie działania w kilku zdaniach:
[list]
[*] Na Twoją pozycję w każdym z 4 rankingów będą wpływać wygrane i przegrane gry.
[*] Jeśli wygrasz - otrzymasz punkty, które poprawią Twoją pozycję. W przeciwnym razie stracisz punkty, co obniży Twoją pozycję.
[*] Rankingi będą realizowane w ramach sezonów, dzięki czemu będziemy mogli wprowadzać zmiany, które znacznie będą wpływać na różne aspekty rozgrywki.
[/list] 

W tej chwili system rankingów jeszcze nie działa, ale jest już on gotowy. Statystyki już są dla Was dostępne i możecie do nich śmiało zaglądać.

[h1]Inne zmiany i poprawki[/h1]
[list]
[*] Zmieniliśmy delikatnie wygląd paska nawigacyjnego w zakładce Opcje
[*] Poprawiliśmy błędne nazwy okien w grze
[/list]

notes.title: Pilotaż rankingów sezonowych
notes.notes:
Przygotowujemy się do wdrożenia systemu rankingowego w formule sezonowej, który doda jeszcze więcej emocji i rywalizacji do naszej gry! 🏆💥 Obecnie trwają prace programistyczne i już niedługo wszystko będzie on gotowy do testów, a Wy – nasi gracze – możecie pomóc nam go doszlifować.

💡 Co przygotowujemy?
✅ Osobne rankingi dla każdego trybu
✅ Główny ranking sezonowy – zbieraj punkty w różnych trybach i awansuj!
✅ Statystyki z gier – śledź postępy w rozwiązywaniu Sudoku!

💡 Jaki jest zarys?
Zasada będzie bardzo prosta - grasz i zdobywasz punkty, które wnoszą Cię na szczyt! Im więcej gier o wyższym poziomie trudności tym większa szansa na sukces. Zadbamy o to aby każdy sezon, który będzie trwał mniej więcej rok był wyjątkowy, dzięki aktualizacjom wpływającym na rozgrywkę.

📅 Kiedy start testów?
Testy rozpoczną się wkrótce – śledźcie nasze ogłoszenia, aby dołączyć jako pierwsi!

notes.title: 🧠 Nowy Tryb: BRAINSTORM w SudokuNexus! 🔥
notes.notes:
Gotowy na prawdziwe wyzwanie? Brainstorm to tryb, który sprawdzi Twoją szybkość myślenia i refleks!

🔹 Zasady? Proste!
✅ Liczby znikają po upływie limitu czasu – zapamiętaj je, zanim znikną!
✅ Wypełnij planszę zanim będzie za późno!
✅ Im szybciej działasz, tym więcej punktów zdobywasz!
✅ Dynamiczna rozgrywka wymaga pełnego skupienia i strategii!

🎯 Dla kogo?
Dla tych, którzy chcą poczuć prawdziwy dreszczyk emocji i podnieść poziom swojej gry w sudoku na nowy wymiar!

🚀 Sprawdź się już teraz i wejdź do gry!

💡 Czy masz dość odwagi, by podjąć wyzwanie Brainstorm? 🔥
